title: OPH-FEP-Synergetics: executable correspondences, obstructions and complementarities across Observer Patch Holography, the Free Energy Principle, and Fuller's Synergetics
description: Forty-four executable probes compare Observer Patch Holography (OPH), the Free Energy Principle (FEP), and Fuller's Synergetics. The suite checks the carrier's exact spectrum and shell arithmetic, native and gated repair dynamics, patch agreement as a cellular sheaf, the finite linear-Gaussian free-energy dictionary and its connection to effective resistance, fifteen obstructions, and the quadray/IVM geometry with exact rational tetravolumes.
